T0NN.1.title: Reproduce and find the root cause
T0NN.1.prompt: Reproduce with `{{command}}`. Trace the cause in {{file or area}}. Change no code in this subtask.
T0NN.1.expect: note holds the exact failing output and a one-sentence root cause that names a file and line.

T0NN.2.title: Add a regression test and fix
T0NN.2.prompt: Add a test in {{test file path}} that fails on the bug, then fix {{file}} at the root cause.
T0NN.2.expect: The new test failed before the fix and passes after; `{{full test command}}` passes.
